infoCards.title: Safety & Compliance
infoCards.description: Integrated safety and compliance management system for chemical operations.

faqData.question: How does the system handle hazardous material management?
faqData.answer: Our system provides comprehensive hazardous material tracking, including SDS management, storage conditions monitoring, and automated safety protocol enforcement.

faqData.question: What regulatory compliance features are included?
faqData.answer: The system includes features for EPA, OSHA, and international chemical regulations compliance, with automated documentation, reporting, and audit trail capabilities.

faqData.question: Can it integrate with laboratory equipment?
faqData.answer: Yes, our solution integrates with various laboratory instruments and LIMS systems, providing seamless data flow between quality control labs and production.
